description: Department of Local Government - Central Province - Declare that E. P. A. R. N. Indrarathne as a Deputy Mayor of the Matale Municipal Council
categorisation: This gazette notification specifically declares the name of a Deputy Mayor for the Matale Municipal Council under Section 66g of the Local Government Elections Ordinance. The content directly concerns an electoral process and the declaration of an elected official's name, fitting the definition of an Elections Gazette (Type 7) which includes "election results and declarations."
